sections.title: Comparing without a new ending
sections.content: You already know olyan..., mint... ("as... as...") from earlier in A2 — it works just as well for prices and products as it did for people. No new grammar here, just a new context for a pattern you already have.

items.english: This one is as expensive as that one.

items.spanish: A kék pulóver nem olyan olcsó, mint a zöld.
items.english: The blue sweater isn't as cheap as the green one.

items.spanish: Ez a táska olyan jó, mint a piros táska.
items.english: This bag is as good as the red bag.

sections.content: You still don't have a dedicated comparative ending ("cheaper", "more expensive") — that's coming much later. Until then, olyan..., mint... covers everything you need to weigh one product against another.
